title: Pan-Seared Fish with Pilaf and Jammy Salsa
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring pan-seared fish served with a side of pilaf and a sweet and tangy jammy salsa.

ingredients.name: Fish fillets (4-6)
ingredients.notes: Choose a mild-flavored fish such as tilapia or cod

ingredients.name: Jammy salsa
ingredients.notes: Made with jammy, dense, and venezuelan ingredients

instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the fish fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, cook the pilaf according to package instructions.
To make the jammy salsa, combine the jammy, dense, and venezuelan ingredients in a bowl.
Stir to combine and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the pan-seared fish with a side of pilaf and jammy salsa.
